documented_policy_exception: Architecture (high altar, steps, rail, retable) cannot be photographed as independent detached museum object. A single clear in-situ photograph of the entire architectural subject may qualify, without counting photos showing many unrelated objects. Portable furnishings/objects still demand strict single-object framing.
rights_policy: No object-year-is-public-domain inference; use exact source photo license; source rights not equal to publication release and no silent CC BY-SA attribution/crop removal.
